q: Kolmogorov complexity K(x) of a binary string x is defined as:
opts: The length of x in bits
The length of the shortest program p for a fixed universal Turing machine U with U(p)=x
The Shannon entropy of the distribution generating x
The minimum number of bits to compress x losslessly
exp: K(x) = min{|p| : U(p)=x} — the length of the shortest program that outputs x on the universal machine U. K(x) depends on U only up to an additive constant (invariance theorem). Most strings have K(x) ≈ |x| (are incompressible).
